text:
Maya: Quick sync — I want to lock sequencing for the new "Runtime SLA Lanes" initiative. Need alignment across product/eng/runtime/infra/security on launch criteria, minimal scope, and required resourcing. Planning doc: https://redwood.internal/roadmaps/runtime-sla-lanes :eyes:
Alex: Thanks — can you call out the must-have launch criteria? customers are asking for clear SLAs.
Maya: Must-haves: p95 latency <= 120ms for gen-1, graceful fallback to smaller model, per-tenant isolation option, and documented E2E test suite. Stretch: dedicated capacity in Q1 pilot.
Sam: From runtime side — to hit p95 targets we need 2 senior runtime engs + 1 infra eng for 6 weeks for batching/kv-cache tuning. If we cut scope (no dedicated capacity in pilot) we can reduce to 1 runtime + 1 infra.
Zoe: Infra: we can provision a limited dedicated pool if finance ok with a month commit. Also need a ticket to reserve GPUs in us-west-2 and configure networking for private deploys.
Liam: Security callouts: KMS integration and threat model signoff required for private deployments. We need 3 weeks for review + remediation window. If product ships without private option, that saves time.
Alex: So tradeoff: earlier public launch vs delayed private-ready launch. Proposal: ship a public-hosted pilot with feature-flagged private deploy (feature gated until KMS & review complete). Thoughts? :thumbsup:
Sam: Agree. Runtime can implement feature flags + model fallback. We'll supply a reduced-resource mode (max tokens 512, smaller beam) to keep costs down for pilot.
Zoe: OK from infra — but log retention and audit hooks differ for private vs hosted. We'll need a short spec for ops requirements.
Maya: I'll draft a minimized launch checklist: 1) perf baseline + KV tuning, 2) infra reservation ticket (#INFRA-872), 3) security threat model + KMS plan, 4) E2E smoke tests, 5) canary with 5 customers.
Alex: Can product reduce the canary to 3 customers to speed rollout? We have 3 early partners waiting.
Liam: 3 partners is fine for the hosted pilot, but private customers must wait for KMS signoff.
ops-bot: Reminder: weekly deploy freeze Thu 18:00 UTC. Schedule canary before Wed to avoid delays.
Sam: I'll open runtime RFC with perf numbers and a config snippet for reduced mode. Example:
text_addendum:
Sam: ```
max_tokens: 512
batch_size: auto
kv_cache: enabled
fallback_model: model-small-v1
```
Maya: I'll update the roadmap now and circulate the checklist + owners. Can we get commitments: Sam (runtime) 6w or 3w reduced? Zoe (infra) reserve capacity by EOW? Liam (security) start threat model by Mon?
Alex: Product supports reduced 3w runtime path to hit earlier date. Zoe: can you confirm infra slot by EOW?
Zoe: Confirmed we can reserve a minimal slot by EOD Fri if finance ok.
Liam: I'll start the threat model Monday and book a 90m review with runtime/security.
Maya: Great — thanks all. I'll post the trimmed checklist and assign owners. Follow-ups in this thread. :sparkles:
